name: durable-native
about: durable-bench's workload (a scripted model calls a lookup tool; ten measured eight-tool turns on a seeded store) on PiG's Go Durable (bench/durableperf, native process, walk model and faux provider as published) and on pi-durable at PiG's pinned Pi version on Node (durable/interop/bench.mjs, node:sqlite). Both seed their own store from zero and must reproduce durable-bench's history fingerprint.
